item.title: Colder tomorrow, winter warm spell kicking in by the weekend
item.description: Winter white is giving way to winter brown as the snowmelt continues, with temperatures expected to remain cold through Wednesday before a winter warm spell begins, lasting through the middle of the month with highs in the 50s and 60s.

item.title: Ash Grove voters approve upgrades for water, sewer systems
item.description: ASH GROVE, Mo. — Voters in Ash Grove on Tuesday cast their ballots to approve/deny city officials the authority to issue and sell over $1.7 million in revenue bonds to improve, extend and equip the town’s water and sewer systems. item.title: Yellville caretaker accused of defrauding elderly woman with dementia
item.description: Laurelye Lunday, 55, of Yellville, Arkansas, has been charged with four felonies, including theft of property, nonfinancial identity fraud, exploiting an endangered or impaired person and computer fraud, after she allegedly defrauded an elderly woman with dementia out of nearly $7,000.
